canberra-31.name: Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve
canberra-31.bio: Nature reserve in the Brindabella foothills with walking trails, live animal displays and the Birrigai Rock Shelter.
canberra-31.hours: 7:30 AM – 8:00 PM (to 6:00 PM outside daylight saving)
canberra-31.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=information (Tidbinbilla Nature Reserve Visitor Centre, node via Nominatim), agrees within ~12 m with the Wikivoyage listing for Tidbinbilla Visitor Centre (-35.440434, 148.942631): HIGH. Visitor point, not the reserve centroid. Moved 3853 m from the placement point.
canberra-31.notes: Day pass per private vehicle (up to 8 seats) $15.53 and reserve hours 7:30-6 winter / 7:30-8 daylight saving, visitor centre 9-5, per the tidbinbilla.act.gov.au/visit page as relayed by a web search; the page is Cloudflare-blocked to scripts so not read directly. Wikivoyage (older) says $11 per vehicle. A 2026 fee determination may raise it to $16.09 from 1 July 2026. Pedestrians and cyclists pay nothing. Not a park-pass spot (no ACT park pass).

canberra-32.name: Canberra Deep Space Communication Complex
canberra-32.bio: NASA deep-space tracking station with a free visitor centre of space exhibits, including a piece of Apollo 11 Moon rock.
canberra-32.coordinates_source: Commons photo median of 35 geotagged files, 258 m from the Wikipedia article point (-35.401389, 148.981667); no OSM feature found. LOW: neither is the visitor centre door. Moved 258 m from the placement point.
canberra-32.notes: Hours and free entry from cdscc.nasa.gov/Pages/opening_hours.html: Sat-Sun 10-4, some additional days in ACT school holidays; closed public holidays per Wikivoyage. The page also holds a commented-out line saying daily 9-5; ignored. Title of cdscc.nasa.gov names the complex. Cafe and giftshop closed. Weekday opening in school holidays means closedDays is approximate.

canberra-33.name: Jerrabomberra Wetlands
canberra-33.bio: Wetland nature reserve with flat walking tracks, boardwalks, bird hides and more than 170 recorded bird species.
canberra-33.coordinates_source: OSM building "Jerrabomberra Wetlands Office", Dairy Road (via Nominatim), ~300 m from the 4-file Commons photo median (-35.31437, 149.16229): the Dairy Road visitor end of the reserve. The OSM nature_reserve centroid (-35.312054, 149.15647) and the Wikipedia point were rejected as centroids. Moved 636 m from the placement point.
canberra-33.notes: The reserve website says open 24 hours, 7 days; Wikivoyage and an earlier VisitCanberra draft say 8 AM-6 PM. Operator site used. Free (no fee on VisitCanberra page or operator site). Visitor point not confirmed against an agency car-park map: parks.act.gov.au blocked.

canberra-34.name: Stromlo Forest Park
canberra-34.bio: Shared-use forest park west of the city with more than 50 km of mountain-bike, running and walking trails.
canberra-34.hours: 6:00 AM – 9:00 PM (to 6:00 PM outside daylight saving)
canberra-34.coordinates_source: OSM building "Stromlo Forest Park Pavillion", Dave McInnes Road (via Nominatim), agrees within ~30 m with the Wikipedia point (-35.320278, 149.025556) and the Wikivoyage listing (-35.32016, 149.025382): HIGH. The draft MEDIUM pin (horse-riding school, 2.3 km away) was rejected. Park hub, not a trail midpoint, since it is a network of trails. Moved 28 m from the placement point.
canberra-34.notes: Hours from Wikivoyage (daily 6AM-6PM, to 9PM in daylight saving; free). 50 km+ trails from VisitCanberra cycling page. VisitCanberra mentions a paid parking model, so parking is charged but is not the price. Official site is a redirect from stromloforestpark.com.au to stromloforestpark.act.gov.au, Cloudflare-blocked.

canberra-35.name: National Capital Exhibition
canberra-35.bio: Free exhibition at Regatta Point on how Canberra was planned and built, with a scale model of the national area.
canberra-35.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=museum (Nominatim), within 20 m of the Wikivoyage point (-35.29042, 149.13117): HIGH. Moved 16 m from the placement point.
canberra-35.notes: Hours, free entry and closed Christmas Day and Boxing Day from the NCA page (title names the exhibition). Open on public holidays 10-4.

canberra-36.name: Blundells Cottage
canberra-36.bio: Stone farm worker's cottage built around 1860, now a free house museum open three days a week.
canberra-36.coordinates_source: OSM building=house "Blundells Cottage", Wendouree Drive (via Nominatim), ~15 m from the single Commons geotagged file (-35.292727, 149.141865): the cottage itself. The Wikivoyage point is a 3-decimal value and was not used. Moved 30 m from the placement point.
canberra-36.notes: NCA page: open Wednesdays, Saturdays and Sundays 10-2, entry free; may close in extreme weather. Wikivoyage lists Sat-Sun only and closed Christmas and New Year's Day; NCA page used (not stating the holiday closures). Bio avoids the stale "lake shore" wording.

canberra-37.name: Commonwealth Place
canberra-37.bio: Lakeside public square in Parkes with the International Flag Display and views over Lake Burley Griffin.
canberra-37.coordinates_source: OSM leisure=park "Commonwealth Place" (Nominatim); the square is about 100 x 50 m, so the feature centre is the visitor point. Within ~100 m of the Wikivoyage International Flag Display point (-35.298, 149.1329). Moved 17 m from the placement point.
canberra-37.notes: Open 24 hours and free: the International Flag Display (110 flags, illuminated at night) per Wikivoyage South Canberra, July 2026; NCA page names the square (completed 2002, jetties, Speakers Square) but gives no hours. The flag display has its own NCA page (/attractions/international-flag-display); treat it as part of this spot, not a second spot.

canberra-38.name: CSIRO Discovery Centre
canberra-38.bio: Science exhibition centre of the CSIRO on Black Mountain, with exhibits on Australian research.
canberra-38.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage Acton listing (-35.27309, 149.11519); resolve-pin found no OSM feature. LOW. Moved 0 m from the placement point.
canberra-38.notes: SHOULD NOT BE ADDED: the Discovery Centre has closed to the general public and in Feb 2025 CSIRO shut it to school visitors too (CSIRO Alumni, "CSIRO shuts education centre after visitor numbers fall", alumni.csiro.au/csiro-shuts-education-centre-after-visitor-numbers-fall/, quoting the Canberra Times). Wikivoyage listing (Mon-Fri 9-4, free) is out of date. Hours, official link and pin are not usable. Fails COVERAGE rule 2 (closed).
canberra-38.ticket_note: no usable official page: closed to the public

canberra-39.name: Canberra Museum and Gallery
canberra-39.bio: Civic Square museum and gallery with a permanent Canberra history display and the Nolan Collection of Sidney Nolan paintings.
canberra-39.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=museum (Nominatim), within 30 m of the Wikipedia point (-35.280682, 149.130628): HIGH. Moved 29 m from the placement point.
canberra-39.notes: Hours Monday-Sunday 10am-4pm from the cmag.com.au homepage (title "Canberra Museum & Gallery"); Wikivoyage's older hours differ. Most exhibitions free, charges may apply for some temporary ones (cmag.com.au/about). Permanent history gallery from Wikivoyage Civic; Nolan Collection managed by CMAG for the Australian Government.

canberra-40.name: Canberra Railway Museum
canberra-40.bio: Volunteer-run railway museum in Kingston where visitors can board historic steam locomotives and carriages.
canberra-40.hours: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM (Sat–Sun and ACT public holidays)
canberra-40.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=museum (Nominatim), within 20 m of the Wikivoyage point (-35.3176, 149.155): HIGH. Moved 69 m from the placement point.
canberra-40.notes: Hours and prices from canberrarail.org.au homepage (adult $10, concession $7.50, child 5-15 $5, under 5 free): Sat-Sun and ACT public holidays 10-3, extra days Wed-Sun in ACT school holidays and Floriade. The /canberrarailwaymuseum subpage still says Sundays only (stale). Site title is "Home"; the site is the museum's (Canberra Railway Museum Facebook/footers). canberrarailwaymuseum.org.au does not resolve.
